approved.description: True only when the reviewer pressed Approve.

round.description: The round this answers. Two verdicts with the same round are the same verdict.

page.description: The page the reviewer was on when they submitted or approved.

kind.description: `general` is a comment on the page as a whole; `pinned` is one about an element on it.

body.description: What the reviewer wrote, trimmed. May hold newlines.

page.description: The page the reviewer was on when they wrote it.

createdAt.description: When it was written, in milliseconds since the epoch.

sentIn.description: The round it went out in: always the round of the verdict it is in.

target.description: What a pinned comment points at, and null for a general comment: the element's `url`, a CSS `selector` that matched it, its `tag`, visible `text`, `box` and the `viewport` it was measured in, the `quote` the reviewer selected, and a `screenshot` of it. The screenshot is a path belonging to the session that wrote the verdict, and it is deleted when that session stops. More fields may be added, so read the ones you know.

items.description: One comment, sent in this round.

comments.description: The comments sent in this round and no other. Empty on approval.

title: Gloss verdict, version 1
description: What `gloss wait` prints on stdout when the reviewer submits a round or approves.
